confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Koh Lanta, Krabi province, Thailand; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and drink anchors are more reliable than accommodation anchors, which assume July low-season (rainy-season) rates with taxes and service charges included and could vary with the specific beach area. FX provenance is weaker than the price estimates: the 0.6955 figure (15 Oct 2026) came from a search summary attributed to the RBA, and a third-party site gave 0.6947 for 16 Oct 2026, which I could not verify on rba.gov.au.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is the Andaman coast of southern Thailand (Krabi and Phuket-area tourist beaches), adjusted down for Koh Lanta's quieter, lower-priced island market. Cocktail and wine anchors use the local price relationship to beer and restaurant prices, since direct knowledge of those prices is weak.
